documents.title: A lithium superionic conductor
documents.abstract: Reports the sulfide solid electrolyte Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) with a room-temperature ionic conductivity of 1.2e-2 S/cm (12 mS/cm), enabled by a three-dimensional conduction framework; among the highest conductivities reported for solid electrolytes at the time. as-reported for engineering demo.

documents.title: High-power all-solid-state batteries using sulfide superionic conductors
documents.abstract: Research article (not a review): reports the sulfide superionic conductor Li9.54Si1.74P1.44S11.7Cl0.3 with 2.5e-2 S/cm (25 mS/cm) room-temperature ionic conductivity and demonstrates all-solid-state cells operating at high power with high-rate cycling. as-reported for engineering demo.

documents.title: Fast Lithium Ion Conduction in Garnet-Type Li7La3Zr2O12
documents.abstract: First report of the cubic garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte Li7La3Zr2O12 (LLZO) with room-temperature lithium-ion conductivity on the order of 1e-4 to 1e-3 S/cm and chemical stability suitable for all-solid-state cells. as-reported for engineering demo.

documents.title: Electrical properties of amorphous lithium electrolyte thin films
documents.abstract: Characterizes amorphous lithium phosphorus oxynitride (LiPON) thin-film solid electrolytes with room-temperature ionic conductivity near 1e-6 S/cm and good stability with lithium anodes. as-reported for engineering demo.

documents.title: Li6PS5X: A Class of Crystalline Li-Rich Solids With an Unusually High Li+ Mobility
documents.abstract: Reports the crystalline argyrodite-family sulfide solid electrolytes Li6PS5X (X = Cl, Br, I) with an unusually high Li+ mobility; Li6PS5Cl shows room-temperature conductivity on the order of 1e-3 S/cm (mS/cm level). as-reported for engineering demo.
